purpose: Reference and next-version corpus candidates. This registry does not change the sealed E3 v1 tuning or held-out split.

required_checks_before_promotion: pin an immutable full commit SHA
confirm the repository language is supported by the measured analyzer
reproduce setup and tests in an isolated checkout
classify network, credential, service, and generated-asset dependencies
measure clean full-suite wall time on the evaluation host
define machine-checkable tasks and reserve the held-out split before tuning
selection_policy.refresh_policy: Stars, forks, default branches, repository size, and activity are observations that may drift. Refresh them when a candidate is promoted; never move a pin inside a sealed corpus version.

candidates.rationale: Language-compatible with the current JavaScript/TypeScript analyzer and directly relevant to the native host path used by this program.
promotion_risks: large checkout and active upstream churn
integration tests may require credentials or external services

candidates.best_role: large external held-out agent/runtime and causal-flow corpus
candidates.rationale: Its Python agent, tool, skill, and MCP surfaces are a strong external test of tracing and causal reasoning without being an ExtendCodeAgent repository.
promotion_risks: must separate deterministic unit gates from live-provider gates

candidates.best_role: small external control for schema, reference, refactor, and trace tasks
candidates.rationale: It is language-compatible and materially smaller than the other candidates, making isolated pins and fast deterministic task oracles practical.
promotion_risks: unlikely to satisfy the required greater-than-ten-minute slow-suite condition
smaller graph may underrepresent scale and cross-boundary failures

candidates.best_role: agent-host architecture, sandbox, protocol, and evaluation implementation reference
candidates.rationale: The maintained implementation is Rust, while the currently measured ExtendCodeAgent analyzers cover Python and JavaScript/TypeScript. Using it now as a formal PI-benefit task corpus would measure unsupported-language behavior rather than the product hypothesis.
promotion_risks: requires a measured Rust analyzer before formal corpus use
large workspace and platform-dependent integration gates
